info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Scripts Asia API
Returns the daily files from Open:FactSet Partner - Scripts Asia.

params.name: _sort
params.description: Enables to get the data in ascending or descending order based on startTime. Results are in reverse chronological order if this parameter is not used.

params.name: _paginationLimit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of results to return per result.

params.name: _paginationOffset
params.description: Specifies the starting point for pagination. This parameter is used to identify the beginning of next set of results. Using this parameter can fetch maximum of first 10000 records.

params.name: trackingId
params.description: Unique Scripts Asia identifier assigned to an event.

params.name: saId
params.description: This parameter filters the results based on saId of the Transcript.

params.name: startDate
params.description: The earliest date of the Scripts Asia file the API should return based on date.

params.name: endDate
params.description: The latest date of the Scripts Asia file the API should return based on date.

params.name: companyName
params.description: This parameter filters the results based on Company Name of the Transcript.

params.name: eventType
params.description:
This parameter filters the results based on eventType of the Transcript.

* 01 = Shareholders Meeting
* 02 = Earnings Announcement
* 03 = Medium-term Management Plan Announcement
* 04 = Analyst Meeting
* 05 = Special Announcement
* 06 = Investor Conference

params.name: languageType
params.description: This parameter filters the results based on language type(either English or local) of the Transcript.

params.name: fileName
params.description: This parameter is used to filters the results based on file name.

params.name: type
params.description: Specifies the type of the file.

items.docs:
Returns XML files and relevant metadata provided by Open: FactSet Partner – Scripts Asia.
- type=delta returns the files from March 1st 2023 to current date.
- type=full will returns the files from start of date until Feb 28th 2023.
